title: Skill Catalog (supersedes specs/001-multi-agent-skill-suite/contracts/catalog.schema.json)
description: Schema for the generated, authoritative catalog at catalog/index.json, as of feature 006. Adds the required `usage` field to each entry so the help skill's all-skills response can be produced from one read of this file. specs/001's schema is retained unmodified as a historical record; this file is the current authoritative shape and the one generate-catalog.sh is written against.

id.description: Derived from the skill's directory name; independent of `name`.

name.description: Human-readable display name; free-form, not required to match `id`.

description.description: One-line purpose and when to use — carries 'applicability' for catalog discovery. 'When not to use' remains body-only in the skill's SKILL.md.

usage.description: One-line guidance on how to invoke/use the skill. Sole carrier of the all-skills help response's Usage field (specs/006-help-skill).
